title: Split PowerPoint – Separate PPTX Slides into Files, Free
description: Split a PowerPoint presentation in your browser: one file per slide or the ranges you type, each with its notes and theme, in one ZIP. No upload.
heading: Split a PowerPoint presentation
subtitle: Split one PowerPoint presentation into several .pptx files, one per slide or by the slide ranges you type; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Split PPTX files online without PowerPoint: choose a presentation, then save each slide as its own presentation or type ranges such as 1-3, 4-8. The file is edited directly rather than redrawn, so each part keeps its slides' speaker notes and pictures and the original theme. The parts come together in one ZIP of .pptx files. Works with .pptx, .ppsx and .potx files. Your file never leaves your device.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: By slide or by range
features.text: Save one presentation per slide, or type the ranges you need, such as 1-3, 4-8.

features.title: Theme and notes kept
features.text: Each part keeps its slides' speaker notes, pictures and the original theme.

stepsTitle: How to split a PowerPoint presentation

steps.title: Choose your presentation
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a .pptx, .ppsx or .potx file on the page.

steps.title: Choose how to split
steps.text: Pick one file per slide, or type slide ranges such as 1-3, 4-8.

steps.title: Split and download
steps.text: Click Split, then download the ZIP with one .pptx file per part.

handles: Split by: one file per slide, or the ranges you type, such as 1-3, 4-8.
Each part: its slides with their speaker notes and pictures, in the original theme.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I split a PowerPoint into separate files?
faq.answer: A PowerPoint presentation can be split by saving copies and deleting the slides each copy doesn't need, in PowerPoint, Keynote, LibreOffice Impress or Google Slides. On this page, pick one file per slide or type the ranges, and every part is made at once in your browser and saved in one ZIP.

faq.question: Does each part keep the speaker notes and theme?
faq.answer: Yes. Each part keeps its slides' speaker notes and pictures and the theme of the original presentation.

faq.question: What happens to comments?
faq.answer: Comments go with their slides: a part keeps the comments of its own slides, and comments on the slides it leaves out are not in it.

faq.question: Can I save single slides as pictures instead?
faq.answer: Yes. PowerPoint to JPG saves each slide as an image, also without uploading.

faq.question: Can I put the parts back together?
faq.answer: Yes. Add the parts to Merge PowerPoint, drag them into order and download one presentation.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
